name: House League (E18-C05 fixture)
note: Test fixture for J03C05 only (--content=house_c05): the House champion (Clean Sweep plus House Rules) on Dry Backend, then Old Lou (House Pins) on House Oil, with the slice's kit and low targets so assist strikes reach both bosses. Not a League players see; E22-L01 wires the real House League.

rivals.name: The Custodian, House Champion
rivals.intro: The Custodian defends the House title with the Proprietor's blessing: only strikes and spares bank, and you throw the House Ball only. Every frame must be clean, with no special ball to fall back on.

reactions.entrance: Mind the corners. I only count what's cleared.
reactions.confident: Untidy. That one goes in the bin.
reactions.threatened: You're closing in… don't leave a mess now.
reactions.victorious: Swept away. Come back with a cleaner game.

rivals.name: Old Lou
rivals.intro: Forty years on these lanes and Old Lou still racks the pins himself. In his match every pin plays as plain Wood: materials switch off, so your Charms, balls and modifications have to make the score.

reactions.entrance: Wood's wood, kid. Let's see your arm.
reactions.confident: Fancy pins won't save you here.
reactions.threatened: Well, I'll be. Slow down, kid.
reactions.defeated: Forty years… and you beat me clean.
reactions.victorious: Come back when you've got more than fancy pins.
